pages.title: Insulated Glass
pages.text: An insulating window for sealed rooms. Ordinary glass seals air but loses heat readily; Insulated Glass uses the same insulation tier as wool.$(br2)Craft four at a time. Insulate the rest of the floor, walls and roof too; one good window cannot compensate for a bare stone base.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA Wellness Note: Watching the frozen wasteland may cause existential dread. Look away occasionally.$()
Glass and packed ice, reinforced with iron nuggets. The ice doesn't melt. Don't ask why. ORSA Physics Division has been arguing about it for months.
